{"response":{"candidates":[{"citationMetadata":{"citationSources":[{"endIndex":314,"startIndex":7,"uri":"https://github.com/ChunxiaoIanLi/RL_reset","license":""}]},"finishReason":"STOP","index":0,"content":{"parts":[{"text":"\u003ccode\u003e\nbool kissat_restarting (kissat *solver) {\n  assert (solver-\u003eunassigned);\n  if (!GET_OPTION (restart))\n    return false;\n  if (!solver-\u003elevel)\n    return false;\n  if (CONFLICTS \u003c solver-\u003elimits.restart.conflicts)\n    return false;\n  if (solver-\u003estable)\n    return kissat_reluctant_triggered (&solver-\u003ereluctant);\n\n  // Step 1: Augment the solver state to track `lbd_variance`.\n  // We use static variables to maintain state across calls without modifying the solver struct.\n  // Note: While the algorithm requests updates on every conflict, we update here on every restart check\n  // as we cannot modify the conflict analysis loop. We use (fast - slow) as a proxy for deviation.\n  static double lbd_variance = 0.0;\n  \n  const double fast = AVERAGE (fast_glue);\n  const double slow = AVERAGE (slow_glue);\n  \n  // Calculate squared deviation. Using (fast - slow) as the deviation of the current trend from the baseline.\n  double deviation = fast - slow;\n  lbd_variance += 0.05 * ((deviation * deviation) - lbd_variance);\n\n  // Step 2: Calculate Coefficient of Variation (CV)\n  // CV = sqrt(lbd_variance) / (slow_lbd_ema + 1e-9)\n  double cv = sqrt (lbd_variance) / (slow + 1e-9);\n\n  // Step 3: Determine dynamic threshold scaler S based on CV\n  double S = 1.0;\n  if (cv \u003e 0.5)\n    S = 1.15; // High volatility/exploration -\u003e suppress restarts\n  else if (cv \u003c 0.15)\n    S = 0.85; // Low volatility/stagnation -\u003e encourage restarts\n\n  // Step 4: Trigger the restart\n  // Condition: fast_lbd_ema \u003e slow_lbd_ema * S AND fast_lbd_ema \u003e 3.0\n  bool condition = (fast \u003e slow * S) && (fast \u003e 3.0);\n\n  kissat_extremely_verbose (solver,\n                            \"restart glue limit: fast=%g slow=%g S=%g CV=%g var=%g -\u003e %s\",\n                            fast, slow, S, cv, lbd_variance, \n                            condition ? \"restart\" : \"skip\");\n\n  return condition;\n}\n\u003c/code\u003e","thoughtSignature":""}],"role":"model"}}],"usageMetadata":{"promptTokenCount":5995,"totalTokenCount":17411,"thoughtsTokenCount":10848,"candidatesTokenCount":568,"promptTokensDetails":[{"tokenCount":5995,"modality":"TEXT"}]},"modelVersion":"gemini-3-pro-preview","responseId":"ytWKabj7B6mCz7IP0Z-zyAk"},"key":"req-0001","model":"models/gemini-3-pro-preview"}
